name: Zakiganj

queries.query: Zakiganj Assam cadastral parcel map official land records GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Government of Assam Directorate of Land Records, ILRMS, and the live NIC Assam Bhunaksha cadastral viewer. Assam Science Technology and Environment Council also documents Assam cadastral mapping under the SIS-DP project. The exact WUP locality was not separately named in the search results.

queries.query: জকিগঞ্জ অসম ভূমি নক্সা চৰকাৰী মানচিত্ৰ
queries.result: Local-language first-party discovery returned Assam's Government land-record pages and Bhunaksha, whose live selector exposes Assamese transliterations and Assam village/cadastral hierarchy. Search also returned Bangladesh Zakiganj pages; those were excluded because the queue record is India and the WUP point is in Assam.

registryEvidence.custodian: Revenue and Disaster Management Department / Directorate of Land Records, Government of Assam; NIC Assam Bhunaksha service
registryEvidence.basis: The official Bhunaksha service is a live Assam cadastral map viewer. Its public hierarchy returned Sribhumi district code 21 and circles including Sribhumi, Badarapur, Nilamabazar, Patharkandi and Ramakrishnanagar, plus village/mouza codes under those circles. This evidences an Assam local/state cadastral map service, but not a verified Zakiganj-specific polygon.

officialSources.observation: Current HTML loads /assets/index-qVUqnX9k.js; the current JavaScript identifies the backend and public routes for district, circle, village, coordinate click, parcel information, map tracing and WMS capabilities.
officialSources.scope: Assam cadastral map viewer; public hierarchy is state/district/circle/village based.

officialSources.observation: Official Directorate of Land Records portal for Assam land-record administration and related services.
officialSources.scope: State land-record custodian prose and service links; not itself a parcel geometry response.

officialSources.observation: Official Assam ILRMS page links citizen Jamabandi, Basundhara and Bhunaksha services.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Assam state cadastral map viewer operated through the Government of Assam/NIC service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public district/circle/village hierarchy was verified for Sribhumi; no safe ID-plus-geometry response was verified for the exact Zakiganj WUP point or a confirmed city-local parcel.

remainingUncertainty: Zakiganj is a low-plausibility queue locality and the exact WUP point was preserved. The official Assam viewer has a public parcel route, but its bounded coordinate lookup failed internally before returning a native parcel identity; no exact-point miss, map-extent miss, timeout, login wall or unusable UI was treated as evidence of citywide absence. No sample GeoJSON is retained.
